answer: The trellis schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the glacier checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 106 effective identities must lock that capital for 68 epochs and keep it locked through every quartz audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 68 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
